subject: CriterionAI POC: kickoff, success metrics, and delivery cadence
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>

Subject: CriterionAI POC: kickoff, success metrics, and delivery cadence

Thanks for the time today — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we lock dates.

POC objective (agreed):
- Validate model quality and latency on your support routing + FAQ workflows and measure cost at production-like throughput.

Proposed success metrics (initial):
- Intent classification: F1 >= 0.85 on your evaluation set
- Latency: median token latency such that tail response for common queries < 250ms (target)
- Throughput: sustain 20 rps for the evaluation test harness across target sequences
- Cost: target unit cost <= $0.08 per 1k tokens (estimate; subject to model choice/quantization)

Proposed timeline & cadence:
- Dataset & access: deliver dataset extract + security questionnaire by 2026-11-18
- Kickoff meeting: propose week of Nov 30 — tentative 2026-12-01 (10:00am PT)
- Weekly 30-min standups (progress, blockers, action items)
- Final readout + recommendation: week of 2026-12-28

Owners (proposed):
- CriterionAI: Lena Ortiz (exec sponsor), Raj Patel (product owner)
- Redwood: Markus Klein (sales lead), Marissa Cole (customer success lead), Avery Johnson (technical lead)

Attachments: I will attach a draft SOW and a milestone calendar for review (see attachments).

Please confirm: 1) that the success metrics capture the right outcomes, 2) dataset availability timeline, and 3) whether Dec 1 works for kickoff or if you prefer a different date.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: CriterionAI POC: kickoff, success metrics, and delivery cadence

Thanks Markus — appreciate the clear recap. Quick notes from our side: 

- Success metrics: F1 0.85 is reasonable. On latency — our product team would prefer a conservative target of median < 300ms given current infra; if Redwood can demonstrate <250ms that would be a win but we should be pragmatic in the SOW.
- Dataset: we can deliver a de-identified support dataset extract by 2026-11-18 as requested. Will it be accessible via S3 or do you prefer a secure upload?
- Security: I'll loop our security team (security@criterionai.com) to complete your questionnaire — they'll need the list of required controls and an expected turnaround time.
- Procurement: legal will want an SOW + pricing in order to route approvals. If you can add an estimated cost range in the SOW that will speed things up.

Proposed kickoff: Dec 1 looks OK for the execs. I'll confirm with our infra lead after they review the dataset plan.

On the SOW PDF you attached: I made one inline comment — can you call out "non-prod data handling" and the cadence for daily log retention during the trial?

Thanks,
Raj
Raj Patel | Product Manager, CriterionAI
raj.patel@criterionai.com
